ev.q: This report describes a case of fatal neonatal TB after successful in vitro fertilization in 2021.
The infant died on the 42nd day of life of TB-related respiratory failure.

public_health_question.v: How did undiagnosed maternal tuberculosis during pregnancy after in vitro fertilization lead to a fatal neonatal TB case, and what evaluation could prevent it?

ev.q: The fatal case reported here might have been avoided by TB prevention or TB treatment during the infertility evaluation or during pregnancy.

ev.q: The infant’s mother underwent in vitro fertilization for infertility in her home country of India
This case underscores the importance of considering TB during an evaluation of women with infertility

notes: Single case report. Figures such as WHO case counts, the ~50% perinatal TB mortality, 24.2% infertility attribution and chest radiography sensitivity (10%–75%) are cited from other sources, not computed here.
